ident.doc: Org subdomain label (TEAM bootstrap: no organisation yet)

supersede.doc: Set when the caller deliberately replaces the plan they already hold. Lifts the already-subscribed refusal; the webhook cancels the replaced subscription once this one is paid.

defer.doc: With supersede, for a same-plan cycle switch: the new subscription starts (trial_end) when the current one expires instead of replacing it immediately; the webhook lets the old one run out (cancel_at_period_end).

promo_code.doc: MKT outreach partner code (Iris/Theo/…). Reserved in YP before Stripe Checkout; applies trial_days + percent_off coupon.

validate_org_ident.doc: Pre-checkout validation of the TEAM org subdomain (ident). Bootstrap exception: scope hub/owner because the payer has no org-domain privilege yet.

promo_code.doc: MKT outreach partner code to preview (read-only: no redemption is reserved).

plan.doc: Plan the shopper is buying — the code may be locked to one plan.

change_plan.doc: Plan/cycle switch on the caller's existing subscription (Team <-> Business). Price swap + metadata rewrite on the live Stripe subscription; never a second checkout.

over_limit_state.doc: Downgrade over-limit: fresh evaluation of the caller's org — recomputes usage/seats vs the current entitlement, persists the two flags and returns state + exact overage numbers for the popup/banner. Any signed-in member may read (the read-only banner is shown to everyone).

over_limit_dismiss.doc: Downgrade over-limit: snooze the owner/admin popup for the CALLING user only, server-side (never localStorage). Cleared automatically when the org returns within limits.

upgrade_nudge_state.doc: Upgrade nudges: asks whether THIS member gets an upsell popup right now (storage 70/80/90%, seats 70/90%, workspace age 14/30d). The server owns both suppression rules -- once per threshold per workspace and a shared daily cap, in yp organisation.metadata.$.upgrade_nudge -- and a granted answer is already marked shown, so the client renders it and writes nothing back. Any signed-in member may ask (the popups go to all members).
